Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 96.04 is in the moderate range. SOFR is secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.478 is a weekly reading for Nov 13, not a live measure.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today: Michigan final consumer survey at 10:00 AM ET and New York Fed Staff Nowcast at 12:45 PM.
  • Funding and broad conditions: SOFR 3.90% effective Nov 18; NFCI -0.478 for week ending Nov 13; MOVE 96.04 on Nov 19; 10-year Treasury 5.04% on Nov 19. These are lagged observations, not live funding measures. Next NFCI release is Nov 25 at 8:30 AM for week ending Nov 20.
  • Policy: Beige Book is scheduled Nov 25 at 2:00 PM ET on the Federal Reserve Board calendar. The Chicago Fed calendar states 3:00 PM ET; this time discrepancy is noted below. October FOMC minutes were released Nov 18 at 2:00 PM and are elapsed. Next FOMC meeting is Dec 8-9, with statement Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM.
  • Thanksgiving: Nov 26 is listed as a Federal Reserve holiday; the Board calendar says daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled that day move to Fri Nov 27. See the selected Nov 27 claims, Census report and H.4.1 calendar entries.
  • Energy and market structure: EIA petroleum report follows the standard Wednesday 10:30 AM schedule Nov 25; natural gas storage is holiday-adjusted to noon. TreasuryDirect lists 13-week and 26-week bill bid closings at 11:30 AM and a 2-year note at 1:00 PM Nov 23.
  • Key dates ahead: BEA October Personal Income and Outlays (PCE) Dec 2; Employment Situation Dec 4; CPI Dec 10; PPI Dec 15; November retail sales Dec 16; and BEA GDP/PCE on Dec 23. CPI and PPI are distinct releases.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date conflict check: the New York Fed November calendar lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM; this verified listing is retained above with a visible conflict warning. BEA's direct schedule instead places Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM, which is also listed. BEA separately confirms November PCE on Dec 23. The conflicting New York Fed entry is not assumed to refer to the same release; confirm against an official update.
  • Beige Book time discrepancy: the dated Federal Reserve Board calendar states Nov 25 at 2:00 PM ET; the Chicago Fed Beige Book calendar gives a general release time of 3:00 PM ET. The dated Board event is used in the calendar; check for an official update before the release.
  • BLS pages were not requested; dates and ET times for Employment Situation, CPI and PPI were checked on the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar. Periods are not stated there and are not inferred. The classifier self-test passed; unmatched rows are provisional Medium with a review note.
  • Selected events from checked primary calendars, not exhaustive; Fed statistical releases are selected, including H.4.1. EIA dates follow its official standard schedules and listed exceptions. The Census calendar lists Nov 25 new home sales and Nov 27 Advance Economic Indicators. No broader claim about market hours is made.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November/December Economic Indicators calendars and SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; BEA; U.S. Census Bureau; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules; TreasuryDirect; U.S. Treasury; Chicago, Philadelphia and Richmond Feds; Conference Board; University of Michigan. Snapshot quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance; yields are official Treasury data.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this is not a full headline-risk review. Near-term verified liquidity and market-structure watch items are SOFR/NFCI readings, Treasury bill/note supply and the Thanksgiving-adjusted energy releases.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Thursday's SPY close fell 1.96%, VIX rose to 28.44 and MOVE eased to 96.04; the 10-year yield fell 3 bp to 5.04%. ES is lower overnight versus Thursday's completed bar. With the final Michigan survey today and a Thanksgiving-shortened week ahead featuring activity data, GDP, energy reports, Treasury supply and the Beige Book, prioritize confirmation from rates, breadth and liquidity; avoid assuming an overnight move will persist. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if releases or Treasury demand materially reprice yields, volatility expands further, or ES fails to confirm with breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Refresh quotes and verify intended contract specifications before execution.
